requirements.text: Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language
Can still code without AI assistance
Hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing, and tools
Has gone far with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex
Reasons clearly about technical tradeoffs and can explain the pros and cons of different approaches
Demonstrated ownership and initiative through a side project, open-source contribution, research project, or startup
Enrolled in or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field
Can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich
Can explain what broke and why

resumes.text:
LENA VOGT

Summary
Computer science graduate with four years of hands-on work in Python and TypeScript. I build backend services, data pipelines and developer tooling, and I like debugging systems until I understand every layer. I use an AI pair-programmer in my editor every day, but I write, read and reason about the code myself.

Experience
Software Engineer Intern, Brightline Analytics, Berlin (June 2025 - September 2025)
- Wrote a Python service that ingests partner sales files and normalizes them into our data warehouse, handling about 40,000 records per hour.
- Built a tool-calling LLM agent with LangGraph that answers analyst questions and runs generated SQL inside isolated Docker sandboxes.
- Cut the nightly deploy pipeline from two hours to ten minutes by parallelizing test stages and caching build layers.
- Wrote postmortems for every production incident, describing what broke, why it broke, and what we changed afterward.

Junior Developer, Kestrel Labs, Hamburg (October 2023 - May 2025)
- Developed TypeScript APIs for an inventory dashboard used by 300 warehouse staff.
- Wrote a design document comparing message queue options for a 5,000 requests-per-second order feed. I weighed latency against durability, and the team adopted the recommendation.
- Maintained a TypeScript validation library used by about 400 developers on GitHub and reviewed 25 external pull requests.
- Ran weekly scripts that compared parser accuracy across model versions and reported regressions to the team.

Education
MSc Computer Science, Helvetia Institute of Technology, 2026
BSc Computer Science, Helvetia Institute of Technology, 2024. In the compilers course I wrote a tokenizer and parser entirely by hand, and the final exam required writing code with no tools at all.

Skills
Python, TypeScript, SQL, Docker, LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Git. English (C2). German (native).

Availability
Two months part-time, fully remote, based in Berlin from February.

MATEO KRAUSE

Summary
Recent BSc graduate in Computer Science with Python experience from coursework and a personal project. I enjoy building small tools that save people time, and I am still learning how larger systems fit together.

Experience
Data Analyst Intern, Nordfracht Logistics, Dresden (February 2025 - August 2025)
- Built monthly shipment reports in SQL and Python, replacing a manual spreadsheet process that took three days.
- Used ChatGPT to draft client emails and summarize weekly reports for the operations team.
- Presented findings to the operations manager every two weeks and updated the dashboard layout based on feedback.

Student Assistant, University IT Helpdesk, Dresden (2023 - 2025)
- Resolved around 15 support tickets per week for students and staff.
- Documented common fixes in a shared knowledge base that is still used today.

Projects
- Personal side project: a Python command-line tool that tracks household expenses. I published it on GitHub and extended it beyond the course requirements with a SQLite backend.
- Database course team project: compared two database options for a reporting tool and wrote a memo for the professor weighing query speed against maintenance effort.

Education
BSc Computer Science, Elbe University of Applied Sciences, 2025

Skills
Python, SQL, Excel, Git, basic JavaScript. English (C1). German (native).

ANJA WEBER

Summary
Registered nurse with six years on a busy cardiology ward, now looking for a career change into an office-based role. I am organized, calm under pressure and good at training new colleagues.

Experience
Staff Nurse, St. Brigid Hospital, Leipzig (March 2019 - present)
- Cared for up to eight cardiology patients per shift and administered medication according to strict safety protocols.
- Built the ward rota in Excel using basic macros, which cut scheduling conflicts by half.
- Trained 12 new nurses on handover procedures and documentation standards.
- Maintained a simple HTML page on the hospital intranet for ward announcements.

Volunteer Fundraising Lead, Leipzig Community Shelter (2021 - 2023)
- Led a volunteer fundraising committee of twelve people for two years and raised about 60,000 euros for winter programs.
- Coordinated monthly events and managed the committee budget.

Education
Diploma in Nursing, Leipzig Health Academy, 2018

Skills
Patient care, medication management, shift scheduling, Excel, basic HTML, teaching and mentoring. English (C1), passed the Cambridge exam last year. German (native).

Availability
Available full-time, on-site in Munich, from April for a full six months.
